court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Danesh Madhukarrao Pahade vs Smita Danesh Pahade, Nagpur
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties took place on 04.02.1991. The respondent displayed mental imbalance and violent nature, causing disturbance in the family atmosphere.

legal_principles.principle: Cohabitation on some occasions does not constitute condonation of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: Mere cohabitation on some occasions, in an attempt to repair the relationship, will not constitute condonation of cruelty.
cited_cases: Uttara Praveen Thool .v/s. Praveen Bhanudas Thool, (2014) 2 Mh.L.J. 321
Smt. Santana Banerjee .v/s. Sachindra Nath Banerjee

legal_principles.principle: Forgiveness and restoration are necessary for condonation.
legal_principles.held: In order to constitute the condonation in terms of Section 23 (1) (b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 there must be forgiveness and restoration and the said act must be bilateral act of both the parties and not the unilateral act of one of the parties.
cited_cases: Uttara Praveen Thool .v/s. Praveen Bhanudas Thool, (2014) 2 Mh.L.J. 321
Smt. Santana Banerjee .v/s. Sachindra Nath Banerjee

outcome.final_order: The trial court's judgment and decree dated 07.11.2008 were upheld, dismissing the petition for divorce on grounds of cruelty, desertion, and mental disorder due to schizophrenia.
